name: Ny Shee
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ny Shee is a Manx folkloric figure. The term belongs to the speech of the Isle of Man. It names the fairy folk that Irish speakers call the Sidhe.
